objective: Improve agreement between LLM and Decisions assignments while retaining useful coverage, and preserve the evidence from every design.
summary:
The three bounded follow-up rounds ended with a negative fresh confirmation: text direct agreement 82.4% → 80.8% (1,000 requests), photographs 98% → 95% (100 photos), Original → frozen Boundary challenger. Matching named IDs over all items also fell: text 80.9% → 79.6% and photos 87% → 85%.

Decisions made identical predictions across both photo guides; the three photo losses came from changed Sol answers. Preselected Sol repeat consistency was 96/100 → 98/100 for text and 25/25 → 24/25 for photos; these subset counts measure repeatability, not semantic accuracy. The development image gain did not reproduce, and the original guides remain the stronger measured confirmation baseline in this study. Complete follow-up experiment API cost was $6.5893167; coding and automated qualitative review compute lie outside that ledger. The log retains every design, development choice and regression below.

Separate evolving-manager full-cohort results improved; their coverage, conditional grouping and maintenance-cost tradeoffs appear in the streaming entry and full results.

rounds.title: Initial streaming implementation
rounds.design: Early live streaming run before the corrected v2 freeze.
rounds.hypothesis: Learn whether an LLM-managed catalog can be paired with Decisions assignments.
rounds.dataset: Earlier runs/main-seed42; not the later held-out photograph cohorts.
conditions: Superseded by the separately frozen v2 experiment.
rounds.decision: Retain the design history; use the verified v2 archive for final earlier-streaming measurements.
rounds.next_question: What changes when the corrected streaming system is frozen?
limits: No final score is imported for this superseded run.

rounds.title: Corrected v2 streaming baseline
rounds.design: Each classifier maintains its own evolving catalog.
rounds.hypothesis: Compare the complete LLM and LLM-plus-Decisions systems.
rounds.dataset: 1,000 CLINC requests and 100 Fashion-MNIST images at 28 × 28 grayscale pixels.
conditions: Same input order and clustering configuration; independent learned catalogs.
ARI compares grouping and is not percent accuracy.
rounds.decision: Keep as the historical streaming benchmark, distinct from later shared-catalog direct agreement.
rounds.next_question: How much disagreement remains when both methods receive one frozen catalog?
limits: The text native cost ledger contains two calls with unknown usage.
Fashion-MNIST is a clothing task, not a natural-photograph benchmark.

rounds.title: Frozen Fashion-MNIST catalog diagnostic
rounds.design: Reuse one LLM catalog to isolate assignment with both backends.
rounds.hypothesis: Catalog evolution may account for some streaming differences.
rounds.dataset: The same 100 Fashion-MNIST items reused from streaming.
conditions: Post hoc reused inputs, not a fresh held-out evaluation.
rounds.decision: Assignment disagreement remains substantial even with a fixed catalog.
rounds.next_question: Does better membership guidance help on fresh text and larger natural images?
limits: Agreement does not establish human-validated accuracy.

rounds.title: Joint rich membership guidance
rounds.design: Discover a shared catalog, freeze category IDs/order/structure, and jointly rewrite descriptions with recognition cues and boundaries.
rounds.hypothesis: Catalog context and membership guidance should improve agreement.
rounds.dataset: 200 text requests and 60 photographs for discovery; a separate held-out cohort of 1,000 text requests and 100 natural photographs (seed 1042).
conditions: Identical examples/catalog within both backends and each description condition.
Fixed K8 first-match paging with Other last.
Preselected Sol repeats and blinded automated semantic review.
rounds.decision: Do not adopt the rich rewrite: direct and named agreement both regress in both modalities.
rounds.next_question: Are wording, competitor repetition, choice position or paging associated with the regression?
limits: Agreement differs from semantic accuracy; same-family review is fallible.
One original-photo review failed; no hidden replacement.
Cost subtotal includes catalog, primary, repeats and review; order diagnostics are recorded separately.

rounds.title: Category order and page-size diagnostics
rounds.design: Reverse the guided category order and separately increase K on a preselected evaluation subset.
rounds.hypothesis: Residual disagreement may depend on option order or page composition.
rounds.dataset: A reused subset of 100 text requests and 25 photographs from the preceding control.
conditions: Post hoc diagnostic, not a new confirmation sample.
Reverse text changes order and page membership together.
K16 photographs have identical request bodies to K8: extra repeats, not a pagination intervention.
rounds.decision: The association warrants a small counterbalanced calibration; it does not justify relabeling returned IDs.
rounds.next_question: Does the association persist on unambiguous constructed cases with every category rotated through every position?
limits: Agreement does not establish human-validated accuracy.

rounds.title: Contextual manager in the full stream
rounds.design: Give the streaming manager the whole catalog, representative members, boundaries and scope-preserving revision instructions.
rounds.hypothesis: Joint context and maintenance should reduce evolving-catalog mismatch.
rounds.dataset: A separate reserved cohort of 1,000 text requests and 100 natural photographs (seed 1042).
conditions: Independent evolving catalogs; report ARI/pairwise metrics rather than direct IDs.
Keep the earlier control and its held-out data unchanged.

The separate evolving-manager experiment improved full-cohort ARI: text 0.538 → 0.610, photos 0.819 → 0.971. Text Decisions coverage rose 70.8% → 90.8%, but the post hoc same 674-item common-named text subset regressed in ARI (0.787 → 0.722). Interpret this coverage/grouping tradeoff alongside increased maintenance and costs; independent evolving catalogs make direct ID percentages inapplicable.
rounds.decision: Interpret complete partition agreement alongside coverage, common-named subset diagnostics and the retirement/reassignment history in the full result section.
rounds.next_question: Does any gain persist after checking coverage and shared rejection?
limits: The contextual manager combines instructions, remembered examples and reconsideration; this comparison does not isolate individual components.
Direct category-ID agreement is inapplicable to independently evolving catalogs. Agreement is not human-validated accuracy.
Common-named subsets are selected after outcomes and condition on all four arms assigning an item. They do not replace full-cohort primary scores or establish semantic accuracy or causality.
